These device logs and journals were collected from Firebase Test Lab runs of the `gemma4-litert-gpu` and `chat-litert-cpu` profiles at consumer source 81eae2c790f29f88af9a8401af300e2489b0368b with LiteRT-LM 0.18.0: a Pixel 9 Pro (API 35, Mali-G715) and a Galaxy S24 (API 36, Adreno 750) on GPU, and the Pixel 9 Pro on CPU as a control. All three runs had 15 of 15 cases PASS. The journals are unmodified. Each `logcat.txt` keeps the buffer header line and the app process's `flutter`, `native`, `litert`, `tflite`, `Dawn` and `TestRunner` lines from the test start record onward, two of its earlier lines, and a few `ActivityManager` lines of another process; the Dart VM service line and every other line were removed. The CPU control registers the GPU accelerator and logs no adapter, WebGPU environment or delegate kernel. Replay verifies binding and reporting behavior; it does not qualify a new device run.
